Signal: "speculative abstraction / is it worth building?" with no demand evidence → `DIRECT → M`, prospective mode. No boundary is being placed, so A/L/C stay unloaded unless M returns BUILD.

## What I found

A plugin system for output formats in a CLI that has one format and zero requests for a second is generality with nothing to instantiate: the pattern's prerequisite — more than one implementation — does not hold today. The gate drops it (the record calls this **DROP**, on a necessity failure, not a budget judgment). The fact that decides it: one format exists and no one has asked for another, so there is no named, probable second format to make the extension point cheap.

## Why it matters

Not building it costs nothing recoverable — a second format, when someone actually asks, is a function plus a flag, and you can extract an interface at the third. Building it now ships a public extension API you cannot quietly retract: third-party plugins pin your internal result shape, your version contract, and your in-process trust boundary, so every later change to what the tool emits has to keep strangers' code working. That is the one-way door the evidence does not justify.

## Do this first

1. Reject the proposal and record the rationale where the idea will resurface (issue or ADR): "no second output format is named or requested; plugin API is a one-way door" — so it cannot be re-proposed without new evidence.
2. If serialization is currently scattered, consolidate it to one call site — no interface, no registry. That is the whole of the "later" preparation and costs no new vocabulary.
3. When the first real request arrives, add that format directly as a second concrete path; revisit abstraction only at the third.

## What I did not check

- The tool's actual code — this directory contains only `.claude/skills/` and `CLAUDE.md`, no CLI source. Whether JSON output is already a single choke point is unverified; check with `rg -n "json\.(dumps|dump)|JSON\.stringify" <src>`.
- Whether any request for a second format exists outside your statement — closes with a search of the issue tracker for format/export/CSV requests.
- Any regulatory or contractual obligation to emit a specific format (§8c floor). If one exists, that format is a direct requirement, not a plugin system, and reopens only the M decision for that format.
